title: Editorial Cards
description: Magazine picks whose landscape art slides in layers as each card moves, with section tabs that jump to a story.
steps: `itemSize` is 76% of the screen width, so a slice of each neighbor shows; `itemAnimation` sinks the neighbors `16` pt and scales them to `0.9`.
Each card's art is a stack of SVG layers, and each layer moves by `relativeProgress` × its depth × `80` pt, so the near hills slide faster than the sun and stars.
`autoplay` advances every `3200` ms with a `650` ms ease-out; a section tab calls `scrollTo({ index })`, and `onSnapToItem` moves its underline.
